name: Wave Assist
description: Smooth wave and ship auto-pilot that rescues you in tight or deadly sections, plus an orb reader that clicks only real orbs and skips deadly ones.

cube-orbs.name: Auto-click real orbs
cube-orbs.description: Cube, ball, UFO, robot, spider, swing. Dash orbs are skipped.

orb-reader.name: Orb reader (skip deadly orbs)
orb-reader.description: Cube only. Simulates click vs no click and skips orbs that lead to death.

rescue.name: Rescue mode
rescue.description: Take over the moment your input would lead to death, even in wide corridors.

smoothness.name: Wave smoothness
smoothness.description: Higher = longer, calmer sweeps. Lower = snappier and tighter.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (s)
lookahead.description: How far ahead it plans. Higher = safer but more CPU.

wave-margin.name: Wave safety margin (units)
wave-margin.description: Extra space kept around hazards. It also grows by itself after crashes.

orb-delay.name: Orb click delay (ticks)
orb-delay.description: Ticks to wait after touching an orb before clicking.

hold-time.name: Keep assist on after danger (s)
hold-time.description: Stops it handing control back too early.
